The United States Embassy in Malabo is the embassy of the United States in the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, in the capital city of Malabo. The embassy is charged with diplomacy and Equatorial Guinea-United States relations. The United States Ambassador to Equatorial is the head of the diplomatic mission of the United States to Equatorial Guinea"

First line maybe title, but we can extract: "Embassy of the United States, Malabo" maybe entity name.

Sentences:

1. "The United States Embassy in Malabo is the embassy of the United States in the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, in the capital city of Malabo."

- Subject: United States Embassy in Malabo (type: embassy or diplomatic mission)

- It also says "is the embassy of the United States in the Republic of Equatorial Guinea". So relation: "representative of" maybe "embassy of". Could be "embassy of" relation: subject embassy, object United States (the sending state) and also "in the Republic of Equatorial Guinea" (receiving state). Could split: "United States Embassy in Malabo" relation "representing country" object "United States". Also relation "located in country" object "Republic of Equatorial Guinea". - subject: United States Embassy in Malabo, relation: "embassy of", object: United States (subject_type: embassy, object_type: country)
- subject: United States Embassy in Malabo, relation: "located in", object: Republic of Equatorial Guinea (type: country)

2. "The embassy is charged with diplomacy and Equatorial Guinea-United States relations."

3. "The United States Ambassador to Equatorial is the head of the diplomatic mission of the United States to Equatorial Guinea"
